## Appearance

Morgan is a short and stout lady. She has gray hair, which she has had since Volume 2, and wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Morgan is a kindhearted and brilliant individual whose natural warmth easily wins the affection of others. Having traveled extensively, she is an excellent storyteller and a delightful conversationalist. Her combination of engaging charm and genuine sympathy leaves a lasting impression on those she interacts with.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Morgan was a famous author and extensive traveler who wrote books about girls and gained a reputation as an excellent storyteller. Although a sprained ankle initially delayed her planned trip to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she eventually visited the residence alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). During the visit, she was entertained by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md), enjoying a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P13](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0013), +54 more_

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is a friend of Morgan who accompanies her on a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During this visit, they are hosted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), enjoying a pleasant dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods together.

- Friend of — friend visiting together  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Morgan's niece. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) helps arrange Morgan's visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), though an initial trip is postponed when Morgan sprains her ankle. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later accompanies her aunt and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) to [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's home for a successful dinner and woodland walk.

- Friend of — acquaintances visiting together  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014)</sub>
